risk_description: The support of the driver compartments (cab) tipping device may break due to poor welding. This could result in an unexpected drop of the opened cab and cause injuries to anyone below.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the requirements laid down in the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
model_types: AA3C, AD3C, 2B3C, BA3C, 2Y3C, AB3C, 1A3C, MS34Y, MTGB3, MTGC4, MTGA2
